method: Compare actual recorded requests and rubric outcomes; no causal or general benchmark claim. Fresh controls were fixed before the experiment. Old controls and a derived previously unrun counterfactual are regressions.
findings: A faithful Korean four-day translation is now accepted.
An English rated-speed claim changed to observed-speed is falsely accepted; baseline v23 rejected it.
The faithful adjoining Gannet backup assertion is still falsely rejected.
The actual saved unsupported using-logs comparison remains falsely approved.
No improvement in overall correctness on the fourteen directly paired controls; do not adopt a setting that exchanges a false rejection for a false approval.
limits: Run order and warm-cache state differ, so wall times are not a controlled latency comparison. Matching wire requests does not prove general causation or language accuracy.
